notes:
The 6 dots select a fold-out section when it is open too
The 6 dots select a folded heading with all its content
A folded heading copies with what it hides

entries.title: The 6 dots select a fold-out section when it is open too
entries.detail: Click the 6 dots beside a fold-out heading, such as Minutes by scripta: the heading and everything under it are selected, open or folded. You see each part of it highlighted.

entries.title: The 6 dots select a folded heading with all its content
entries.detail: Click the 6 dots beside a folded heading: it is selected with everything under it, and says how many hidden blocks come along. Copy, cut, delete or drag it, and all of it goes. The heading stays folded.

entries.title: A folded heading copies with what it hides
entries.detail: Select a folded heading, with its 6 dots or all its words, and copy: the text under it comes along, as Minutes by scripta with its summary, decisions, tasks and open points. Cut takes it all too. The 6 dots no longer open the heading they select.

entries.title: Move, copy and sort sections
entries.detail: A section's menu has Move to notebook… and Copy to notebook…: the section goes on top of the notebook you pick, with its pages and page groups, their pictures and files. The sections column has a sort button, as the page list does: Sort by name A → Z or Z → A. An ETH section you move keeps getting its OneNote changes in its new place.

entries.title: Frozen pages leave the OneNote list
entries.detail: Settings › OneNote no longer lists pages made in OneNote more than 30 days ago under "Left as they are": the evening update does not look at them any more.

entries.title: Older ETH OneNote pages are frozen
entries.detail: The evening OneNote update now takes only pages made in OneNote in the last 30 days. Older pages stay as they are in folia: change them there. Copy fresh from OneNote in a page's menu still takes any page by hand.

entries.title: Deleted ETH pages stay deleted
entries.detail: A page from your ETH OneNote that you delete in folia no longer comes back. Before, the evening OneNote update added it again as a new page once the Bin had deleted it for good after 30 days.

entries.title: Empty bullets, dollar signs and links behave
entries.detail: A copied page keeps its empty bullets and tasks as empty lines: before, an empty bullet could become the text "-", and one under another bullet turned that bullet into a heading. Two "$" in one line stay text and no longer become a formula. A click after a link at the end of a line puts the cursor there and no longer opens the link.

entries.title: The Markdown copy checks folia’s database at every run
entries.detail: A Mac that had missed changes, for example while its connection had quietly stopped, wrote nothing new into the Markdown copy. Now each run compares the notebooks’ pages with the database, so every change reaches the copy within five minutes.

entries.title: Copy fresh from OneNote keeps each file in its place
entries.detail: On a OneNote page with a file above a picture, a copy put the file’s card on the picture and the picture on the file. Now each file stays where it stands, and a fresh copy of such a page puts its files back.

entries.title: Both Macs show the same notebooks, and write the same Markdown copy
entries.detail: A Mac that slept or was offline missed the changes made meanwhile, such as renamed pages and the ETH daily update, until folia started again. It now reads them as soon as it is back online. The Markdown copy is now written from folia’s database, so a Mac that is behind never writes old titles or old text into the folder, and two Macs taking turns write the same files. Search reads every page once more after this update, so it finds what the pages say now.

entries.title: scripta’s minutes stay apart from your notes
entries.detail: scripta now writes a meeting’s summary, decisions, tasks and open points under one heading, Minutes by scripta, at the end of the page. Your own notes stay as you wrote them. Click the arrow before the heading to fold the minutes away. Copy fresh from OneNote and the ETH daily update keep them.

entries.title: Large pages open without a moment offline
entries.detail: A page changed often could grow very large in the background, with data folia no longer needs, and showed Offline for a second each time you opened it. Such a page now gets small again the first time you open it, and folia sends only what the server does not have yet.

entries.title: Font colours from OneNote
entries.detail: Copy fresh from OneNote and the ETH daily update now keep the colours you gave words in OneNote, in the nearest of folia’s colours. Headings keep folia’s own look.

entries.title: OneNote copies of a page come into folia
entries.detail: A page you make in OneNote as a copy of an older page now comes into folia with the ETH daily update, as a page of its own. Before, folia took it for the older page and left it out.

entries.title: Line marks in lists back in the margin
entries.detail: A question, important or confidential mark on a list line stood in the middle of its text since the last update. It is in the left margin again, in one column with the other marks, also while the line is picked with its 6 dots.

entries.title: Selected list lines look even
entries.detail: When you select several lines of a list, every line is now highlighted alike. Before, the first row of each line after the first looked brighter, as the Mac app highlighted its bullet a second time. Bullets and numbers are now drawn by folia and look as before.

entries.title: Markdown copies with attached Markdown files
entries.detail: A page with a Markdown file attached stopped its notebook's Markdown copy: folia took the attached file for a note it had not written, and kept no copy in that folder any more. Attached files are folia's own now, and the copy runs again.

entries.title: Less memory, a quicker start
entries.detail: Search keeps your pages in a smaller form: with 8,000 pages, folia needs less than half the memory it did. The sign-in page loads about a fifth of the code it loaded before; the editor comes once you are signed in.

entries.title: Safer and quicker
entries.detail: An SVG picture can no longer run code when it is opened in a tab of its own. A mention in a comment shows the person it really tells. A reader of a notebook no longer gets its tasks in tabula, and finishing one there no longer ticks it in the page. On the Mac, folia writes only Markdown files in a folder you opened, and other files only in its _assets folder. Typing on a page with tabula task links is a little quicker.

entries.title: Alert says when it cannot work
entries.detail: In a list line a note cannot start, so the Alert button is grey there. On hover it says "not in a list". Before, it looked ready but did nothing.

entries.title: Six dots for each list line
entries.detail: Each line of a list has its own six dots, left of its bullet. A click selects that line and the lines under it, and a drag moves them together. Before, the dots took the whole list, and two lists that touch look like one.

entries.title: Copy or move a page, and you go with it
entries.detail: After Copy to section… or Move to section…, folia opens the page where it went: the copy, or the moved page, in its new section. Of several pages, the one that was open, else the first.

entries.title: A list line moves alone
entries.detail: Backspace at the start of a list line joins it to the line above, and Delete at its end joins the line below. Tab moves only the line one level in. The lines below keep their level and their place. Backspace in the first line of a list still takes its bullet away.

entries.title: Links to this page show the notebook
entries.detail: Each page in Links to this page shows its notebook's icon, as in the sidebar: its letter on its colour, or a book for a wiki space. Then comes the notebook, a section group if there is one, and the section.

entries.title: Links to this page in every notebook
entries.detail: The foot of a page lists the pages that link to it, in every notebook, not only in wiki spaces. A click opens one. A page no other page links to shows nothing there.

entries.title: Link to page from the toolbar
entries.detail: A new button beside Link types [[ for you, and the list of pages opens. Select words first, and the list shows the pages they name, or offers a new page of that name. If you had set up your toolbar, folia adds the button once; Settings › Toolbar moves or hides it.

entries.title: Hide the cursors of others on a page
entries.detail: Settings › General › Others' cursors. Switched off, a page shows no cursor, name or selection of another person, and no faces beside its dates. They still write with you, and you still see what they write.

entries.title: Focus and Typewriter mode are buttons in the top bar again
entries.detail: They left Settings › General. Two buttons in the top bar switch them on and off, beside Page alone, and ⌘K still has them. If you had set up your top bar, folia adds the two once; Settings › Top bar moves or hides them.

entries.title: Tab indents a list item again everywhere
entries.detail: Some pages hold two lists right after each other that look like one. Tab in the first item of the second list did nothing and sent the cursor away. Now the two lists become one and the item goes under the item above it. Where an item cannot move, Tab keeps the cursor in the text.

entries.title: Fold and open a heading beside its words
entries.detail: A click on the empty space right of a fold-out heading's words opens or folds it, and your cursor stays where it was. There the pointer turns into a hand and says Fold. A click on the words still lets you edit them.

entries.title: Fold-out headings open with a click on their words
entries.detail: A folded heading now opens when you click anywhere on it, not only on its arrow; the cursor goes there too. If you may only read the page, a click opens and folds it. A search hit or a comment inside a folded part opens that part by itself.

entries.title: Confluence tables and headings imported whole
entries.detail: A table whose row headers hold paragraphs no longer breaks apart into text with "|" signs, and a heading that starts with a line break or holds a table of contents stays one heading. Import the space again to get the fixed pages.

entries.title: Columns in a page: one, two or three
entries.detail: The toolbar has One column, Two columns and Three columns. Two or three put empty columns below the line you are on; in columns they change how many there are, and One column puts everything back on the page, nothing lost. On a narrow page the columns stand one below the other. A Confluence import now keeps the columns of a page, as on the space's home page. New tools: if you set up your toolbar yourself, add them in Settings › Toolbar.

entries.title: Document pictures in a Confluence import, with no extra step
entries.detail: In the Mac app, Import Confluence export… now draws the picture of each Word, PowerPoint or PDF page that Confluence shows, by itself, and puts it above the file, also in a table cell. No script to run first.

entries.title: A new page opens at once, also after an import
entries.detail: A page that folia opened while it was still saving it could say "No access to this page" until a reload, for example the home page right after a Confluence import. folia now asks again a second later and opens it.

entries.title: A Confluence import that looks like Confluence
entries.detail: Import Confluence export… now keeps what Confluence draws in the browser: the page trees and child page lists, tables of contents, recent updates, version history and file lists. Coloured text keeps its colour, a row's own header is bold, and a price like $5 / $30 stays text.

entries.title: Calmer marks for commented words
entries.detail: Words with a comment now sit on a soft grey pill instead of an amber line. The words of the comment you have open get a slightly stronger grey.

entries.title: Comments: jump to the words, and @ to mention
entries.detail: Click a comment in the Comments window, and the page goes to the words it is about, with them selected. Typing @ in a comment or a reply opens the same list of people as in the page; pick one with the mouse or Enter.

entries.title: All side windows the same width
entries.detail: Comments on the right is now as wide as Meetings, Outline and History, so the page keeps the same room whichever side window is open.
